<function name="GetInt" parent="IMaterial" type="classfunc">
	<description>Returns the specified material value as a int, rounds the value if its a float, or nil if the value is not set.

<note>Please note that certain material flags such as `$model` are stored in the `$flags` variable and cannot be directly retrieved with this function. See the full list here: <page>Material Flags</page></note>
</description>
	<realm>Shared and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="materialInt" type="string">The name of the material integer.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">The retrieved value as an integer</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
